tier2.headline: Your data retained for 10 years
tier2.quote: We use Braze , Salesforce , Fundraise Up and Campaign Monitor to email receipts and store records, which are retained for 10 years from the date of last payment.

tier2.headline: Your data transferred globally
tier2.quote: When Mozilla (that’s us) collects information about you, our Mozilla Privacy Policy describes how we handle that information.

tier2.headline: Your data shared with authorities
tier2.quote: We respond to all requests we receive from individuals wishing to exercise their data protection rights in accordance with applicable data protection laws.
